title.narrative: Strengthening Technical and Vocational Education and Training Project

description.narrative: The project seeks to improve the quality of, and access to, formal technical and vocational education and training (TVET) in the Lao PDR, focusing on certificate and diploma programs. Quality improvements include developing skill standards, improving curricula, and training teachers in four priority skill areas: (i) construction and building trades, (ii) mechanical and machinery maintenance and repair, (iii) furniture-making, and (iv) basic business. Access and equity will be enhanced through the introduction of a voucher assistance training scheme and construction of dormitories. A key project focus is on increasing private involvement in TVET and achieving greater alignment between TVET and labor market needs.
